literal_meaning: গলা পর্যন্ত বা গলায় গলায় (neck to neck or up to the neck)
figurative_meaning_en: up to the neck or immersed deeply
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ঋণে গলায় গলায় ডুবে আছে।
কাজের চাপে তার জীবন গলায় গলায় হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is up to his neck in debt.
She is neck-deep in work pressure.
note: Commonly used to express being deeply involved or troubled in something, often negative contexts like debt or obligations.
